title: Sheet-metal self-heal: sheet_metal_suggest_fix
summary: Closes the AI self-heal loop — for each manufacturability violation, return the concrete parameter change that resolves it (radius up, flange longer, bends spread, hole moved).
details:
## What's New

- **`sheet_metal_suggest_fix` MCP tool**: takes a session document (and optional shop profile), runs the check, and translates each structured `Violation` into a typed `Fix` an agent can act on — `increase_radius`, `increase_flange_length`, `shorten_or_split_bend`, `move_hole_or_clearance`, `separate_bends`. Each carries the new numeric target plus a human-readable description.
- Pass `violation_index` to target one, or omit to get a fix for every open violation.

With create → check → suggest_fix → re-create → re-check, an LLM agent can iterate to a manufacturable part with no human in the loop — the spec's headline AI bet.
